text:
glasses_felix: Extremely volatile. Day 24 09:10 was bathroom_shelf_ba1 (missed by predicting nightstand_b1). Day 23 showed rapid switching between bathroom_shelf_ba1 and coffee_table_l1. Do not assume nightstand_b1. Check bathroom_shelf_ba1, coffee_table_l1, and desk_b1.

tablet_felix: Highly volatile. Day 24 10:06 was kitchen_table_k1 (missed by predicting coffee_table_l1). Day 23 18:36 was also kitchen_table_k1. Kitchen_table_k1 appears to be a strong candidate for late morning/evening, but coffee_table_l1 remains possible for other times. Check kitchen_table_k1, coffee_table_l1, and floor_k_k1.

mug_felix: Variable. Day 24 10:09 was kitchen_table_k1 (missed by predicting coffee_table_l1). Day 21 showed both coffee_table_l1 and kitchen_table_k1 in the afternoon. Stop assuming coffee_table_l1 is the primary spot for late morning. Check kitchen_table_k1 and coffee_table_l1.

glass_felix: Variable. Day 24 13:00 was kitchen_table_k1 (missed by predicting coffee_table_l1). Day 20 evening was counter_k1; Day 18 evening was kitchen_table_k1. Day 26 22:59 was cupboard_k1 (missed by predicting kitchen_table_k1). Kitchen_table_k1 is frequent midday, but cupboard_k1 is a strong candidate for late night. Check kitchen_table_k1, cupboard_k1, and counter_k1.

book_felix: Consistently at coffee_table_l1 in the afternoon. Day 16 AM, Day 15, and Day 14 were all coffee_table_l1. Stop assuming couch_l1. Check coffee_table_l1.

razor_felix: Persistent morning error. Assumed medicine_cabinet_ba1 on Day 20; actually at bathroom_shelf_ba1 on Day 20, 15, 14, 13, and 7. Day 26 08:47 was sink_ba_ba1 (missed by predicting bathroom_shelf_ba1). The location is not fixed to the shelf; it moves between sink_ba_ba1 and bathroom_shelf_ba1. Check both sink_ba_ba1 and bathroom_shelf_ba1 for morning queries.

water_bottle_felix: Persistent afternoon error. Assumed dish_rack_k1; actually at coffee_table_l1 on Day 18 (09:54), Day 15, and Day 14. Stop checking dish_rack_k1 or entry_floor_e1. Check coffee_table_l1 for water bottles in the morning/afternoon.
